notes_for_editor: Single tower-specific source (Forest Lookouts), giving only the 1964 build and 1979 removal dates. Two web searches found no other record of the tower, its design, height, staffing or fires. A county and agency match the brief. The brief's removed status is supported; no corrections. The onX campsite listing near Crystal Mountain is a different use of the name and was not used. Encyclopedia statewide figures (46 standing in 2023) and Preserve Arkansas ('about 40' remain) differ; not used.
